title: 95 ## Arrest by Sex Table 36 presents the sex-wise distribution of juvenile apprehended during 1963 to 1972. During this period there had been an overall increase of 149.6%. But the trend of increase among the girls was much sharp than those in that of boys where it was 194.9% for girls as against 147.4% for boys. The percentage involvement of girls to the total juveniles and youthful offenders indicated an erratic trend from year to year. It increased from 4.8% in 1963 to 7.5 in 1967, but thereafter, it started decreasing up to the year 1970 when it was 4.3. But from 1971 onwards it again started increasing.
